title: Failing grades by department
statementMd:
Count scores below 60 per course department. Show departments with at least one.

Expected columns: `department`, `failing`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.department, COUNT(*) AS failing FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.score < 60 GROUP BY c.department;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
